what: The versions of the TEXT of https://newsroom.sgit.ai/publishers/index.html (admin/content/publishers/page.md), oldest first. A change to the text is the next minor version; a rewrite is the next major, the editor's call. text_sha256 is the sha256 of page.md as that version was built; admin/build/publishers.py stops when page.md no longer matches the newest entry. Each version is frozen at publishers/versions/<version>.md by the release that made it. The live parts of the page (features, newest articles, the five to start with) are not part of the text; publishers/changes.json records what they did per release.
